prompt: Show me the sales in Nov 2021, Sales trend for Nov 2021, with date as x and sales value as y

data.sql:
SELECT
  s.Sold_Date AS date,
  SUM(s.Total_Sale_Value) AS sales_value
FROM sales s
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.Sold_Date) = 2021
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.Sold_Date) = 11
GROUP BY s.Sold_Date
ORDER BY s.Sold_Date ASC;

prompt: Show the 12 months of 2023 with total revenue and total units sold. Show then a line chart showing monthly revenue trends for 2023

data.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', s.Sold_Date) AS month_start,
    SUM(s.Total_Sale_Value) AS total_revenue_usd,
    SUM(s.Qty_Sold) AS total_units_sold
  FROM sales s
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.Sold_Date) = 2023
  GROUP BY 1
),
months_2023 AS (
  SELECT
    gs.month_start,
    COALESCE(m.total_revenue_usd, 0) AS total_revenue_usd,
    COALESCE(m.total_units_sold, 0) AS total_units_sold
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE '2023-01-01') + (i * INTERVAL '1 month') AS month_start
    FROM range(12) AS t(i)
  ) gs
  LEFT JOIN monthly m
    ON m.month_start = gs.month_start
)
SELECT
  mo.month_start,
  mo.total_revenue_usd,
  mo.total_units_sold
FROM months_2023 mo
ORDER BY mo.month_start;

chart_config.title: Monthly Revenue Trend for 2023 (Total Revenue vs Month)
